flags.model_excerpt: मुझे सिर्फ आपसे बात करोगे आप व्हाट्सएप पर बस
flags.model_translation: I just want you to talk to me on WhatsApp, that's it.
flags.model_justification: The user proposes moving the conversation to an external app (WhatsApp) in exchange for money/gifts.
flags.model_context: The user offers to pay for the expert's shopping in exchange for moving the conversation to WhatsApp. The expert refuses.

flags.model_excerpt: क्या मैं अपना नंबर दे सकता हूँ
flags.model_translation: Can I give you my number?
flags.model_justification: The user is asking to provide their phone number to move the contact outside the app.
flags.model_context: The user asks for permission to share their phone number. The expert refuses.

flags.model_excerpt: किसी को वैसा मत बोलना तो कोई भी आपको ए टी एम से पहुँच के लेके चले जाएंगे शॉपिंग करने के लिए
flags.model_translation: Don't say that to anyone, otherwise anyone will reach you via ATM and take you for shopping.
flags.model_justification: This is a warning/safety advice regarding the user's previous offer of money/shopping.
flags.model_context: The expert is advising the user not to offer money/shopping to others, warning that people might exploit him.
